# Support

## How to contact us

Need help with Nightwatch? Our support team is here to assist.

You can reach us through the following channels:

> [card] [Email](mailto:nightwatch@laravel.com)
>
> Send us a message and we’ll get back to you promptly.

> [card] [In-App Chat](https://nightwatch.laravel.com/dashboard)
>
> Select **Support** from the contextual menu next to your name in the
> Nightwatch app to open a conversation with our team.

If you're a customer on a paid plan, your requests are prioritized automatically.
